notes: Every wave's title and sub agree with its item (parts:4 / cut 1/4 with 'chaar', cut 1/3 / parts:3 with 'teen'), and with no cut marks the child must judge equal size herself, so unequal cuts get 'PAAS' / 'itna chook' feedback, which shows a child with the mix-up that uneven pieces are not quarters or thirds. Minor points that are not faults: 'silisila' is a misspelling of 'silsila', the sub 'Chaar tukde sab ek jaise hone chahiye' states the rule rather than letting the child find it, the coach line 'Barabar tukde dekho' is low-contrast but legible, and p360 was not supplied.

The child places one unit fraction at a time (1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/3, 1/6) on a single 0-1 line, so 1/8 lands nearest 0 and 1/2 in the middle. That puts the whole-number-bias belief (1/8 > 1/4) where it visibly fails, and no title or sub gives a position away. Not counted as faults: 1/3 and 1/6 do not fall on the 8 scaffold ticks (I cannot tell how strictly 'EXACT' is graded there), several strings are English inside Hinglish ('Run complete', 'Toughest', 'SAME SPOT', 'landed'), the coach line 'Fraction ko line par pakdo' is low-contrast but legible, and p360 was not supplied.
